templates.name: bugfix
templates.sentence: Pays 50 test USDC when checks `lint`, `unit` pass on a merge that only touches src/ and tests/; refund after 14 days
templates.comment: /knos fund 50 checks: unit, lint paths: src/**, tests/**

templates.name: feature-blackbox
templates.sentence: Pays 80 test USDC when check `unit` passes on a pull request that also passes the issue's black-box acceptance suite; refund after 14 days

templates.name: milestone
templates.sentence: Pays 100 test USDC when check `unit` passes on a merge; 20% of it waits 30 days and goes back if the change is reverted; refund after 30 days
templates.comment: /knos fund 100 checks: unit holdback 20 warranty 30 days 30

templates.name: private-attested
templates.sentence: Pays 50 test USDC when check `unit` passes on a merge that only touches src/; funded and paid by the organisation's attestor repository, so nothing public names the private one; refund after 14 days

templates.name: standing-rate
templates.sentence: Pays @octocat 10 test USDC for each pull request of theirs, up to 100 test USDC in all, when check `unit` passes on a merge; refund after 90 days
templates.comment: /knos offer @octocat rate 10 budget 100 checks: unit days 90
